description: This file contains operator microbenchmarks for scaled matrix multiplication (`scaled_mm`) in PyTorch, including configuration functions, class definitions for benchmarking, and platform support checks.

classes.name: ScaledMMBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmarking class for scaled matrix multiplication (`scaled_mm`) supporting various scaling modes and platform-specific configurations.

methods.name: _should_generate_scaled_mm_configs
methods.description: Determines whether to generate scaled_mm configurations based on platform and PyTorch version.

methods.name: _supports_fp8_rowwise_fp32_output
methods.description: Checks if FP8 row-wise kernels with FP32 output are supported on the current device.

methods.name: _supports_scaled_mm_benchmark
methods.description: Checks if scaled_mm benchmark is supported on the current platform, considering PyTorch version, CUDA capability, and ROCm support.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the benchmark with matrix dimensions, device, scaling mode, and data types.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the scaled matrix multiplication using configured scaling and data types.
